title: Fire alarm test - Thursday 10:00
body: The weekly alarm test lasts about a minute. No need to leave the building.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
body: Ask at reception for a guest Wi-Fi voucher. Vouchers last for one day.

title: Lunch and learn, Friday 12:30
body: "Getting more out of the new booking system" in the Boardroom. Sandwiches provided.

title: Visitor parking
body: Bays 1-6 at the front are reserved for visitors. Please leave your registration at reception.
